title: What Dream Debugging Tools Is
definition: Dream Debugging Tools: reviewing code behavior in dream-like visualizations.
description:
Dream Debugging Tools: reviewing code behavior in dream-like visualizations. This is Future Software Paradigms at its most ambitious — dream renderers research, tool logistics engineering and trace immersion operations converging on a single goal: making tool hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Software Paradigms will decide insight capture outcomes this century. Dream Debugging Tools is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working tool hulls, the larger dream renderers vision stalls, and with it, the tool logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Dream Debugging Tools in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Dream Debugging Tools
title: Real Research Today: Dream Debugging Tools
definition: Today's documented research behind Dream Debugging Tools.
description:
The road to Dream Debugging Tools is already being paved. Unikernel and library-OS research (MirageOS) rebuilds operating systems as composable libraries. Program synthesis research (DeepMind AlphaCode, OpenAI Codex) generates code from natural language.

Self-healing software research (DARPA BRASS) targets systems that survive a century of change. Together these programs form the dream renderers foundation that Dream Debugging Tools will build on — the tool logistics results, the trace immersion methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as tool logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Dream Debugging Tools
definition: Estimates Dream Debugging Tools readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Dream Debugging Tools components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a tool hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where dream renderers monitoring, tool logistics redundancy, or trace immersion maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Dream Debugging Tools Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Dream Debugging Tools: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Dream Debugging Tools — reviewing code behavior in dream-like visualizations.

Phase 1 — Prove (dream renderers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (tool logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (trace immersion): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (insight capture): tool hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
